symbols.read: Price has extended the breakdown to 746.48, confirming the bearish bias from the prior read — the 1H trend remains down and the 752.39–754.35 bear FVG still caps upside, with the 758.57 lower pivot now the clear reclaim line for any bullish flip. The setup stays SELL but remains flagged MISSED, as entry at 758.57 is well above current price and the move toward 721.33 is already in progress. The BULLISH regime tag continues to conflict with the bearish 4H, so conviction rests on the 4H/1H alignment rather than the regime. Invalidation is unchanged: a reclaim of 758.57 flips the read, stop 775.89, target 721.33.

The SELL signal has been invalidated as price holds above the 82,227.56 lower pivot, with Combined flipping to HOLD while 4H remains Bearish — the downside case is now stalled rather than confirmed. The 1H has ticked up (+0.17%) off 82,592.01, keeping the 82,227.56 pivot as the line that must break to reopen the 77,730.00 target; a stop at 82,413.00 sits just above it. The two overhead bear FVGs at 83,396.61–83,429.27 and 83,643.23–83,962.00 remain the supply zone capping any recovery, and only a clean reclaim of 83,962.00 would revive the 86,725.12 objective. Bias is neutral-to-bearish: no fresh short while HOLD holds, but the structure stays capped until those FVGs are cleared.

Price has broken below the 2,527.57 lower pivot to 2,526.10, confirming the invalidation condition flagged in the prior read and re-arming the bearish case toward 2,320.59. The bias shifts from neutral-cautious to outright bearish: the 4H remains bearish, the 1H has flipped to a downtrend, and the combined posture stays HOLD only because the 1H's last candle closed green (+0.25%). A new bearish FVG has opened at 2,546.43–2,553.65, replacing the erased bullish one and capping any upside retest. The short setup (entry 2,527.57, stop 2,537.64, target 2,320.59) has already expired, but the structure favors continuation lower; reclaiming and holding above 2,527.57 would be needed to neutralize this read.

Bias stays bearish and the prior read's path has played out: price broke the 110.20 shelf and has now reached 108.62, sitting just above the 108.23 target, with the 4H direction still bearish and the 1H trend down. The key change is that two bearish FVGs have opened at 109.26–109.70 and 111.09–111.45, giving overhead supply that was absent before, so any bounce should stall below 109.70. The SELL setup remains missed (entry 115.26, stop 115.26, target 108.23), and with price already at 108.62 the target is nearly filled — chasing here is poor risk. Invalidation: a 4H close back above 109.70 would fill the lower FVG and neutralize the immediate downside, while reclaiming 115.26 voids the bearish structure entirely and opens 122.29.

The combined 4H+1H has flipped from HOLD to SELL, confirming the bearish 4H flip flagged previously and revising the bias from neutral-to-cautious to outright bearish. Price has slipped further to 60.26, now below the 61.45 entry trigger, with the 1H trend down and no open FVGs to cushion the downside — the same structural weakness noted last read has only deepened. The long setup is effectively dead below 61.45, and the 58.50 lower pivot remains the level that re-arms the short; a break there opens the downside, while reclaiming 61.45 would be needed to revive any constructive case.

Bias remains HOLD and has tilted more defensive: price at 4,165.16 is marginally below the prior 4,168.44 read, the 4H direction has now flipped to bearish, and the 1H trend stays down, so the combined signal offers no long trigger. The bearish FVGs at 4,196.13–4,201.70 and 4,193.00–4,193.79 remain overhead resistance, keeping the entry pivot at 4,217.40 with the stop nudged down to 4,209.88. Invalidation for the long is a sustained push above 4,217.40, which opens the 4,368.26 target; until then the setup is off, with 4,066.53 the downside reference.

Price has broken below the 1.39 lower pivot to 1.37, confirming the prior short bias, but the combined 4H+1H signal has shifted from SELL to HOLD and the entry remains invalidated — the setup is now stale rather than actionable. A fresh bearish FVG at 1.38–1.38 sits directly overhead, reinforcing that any bounce into 1.38–1.41 faces supply, with the 1.41 FVG still capping. Holding below 1.39 keeps the 1.25 target in play; a decisive reclaim above 1.39 and the 1.41 FVG invalidates the short and restores the 1.39–1.53 range. Regime stays BULLISH, so this remains a counter-regime short — size accordingly.
